title: Re-Volt/Techniques
text:
Here are some techniques that you can learn while playing the game, these techniques aren't needed for casual gameplay, but they can help you improve your experience and skill you have for the game, as well as making tracks where these techniques are applicable to be more manageable.

Drifting

In order to perform make 180º turns, you must slow down before turning which will help you stay on road and make successful turning. This technique is called "Drifting".

Passing Secret Passages

Look for Secret Passages on each track, they will help you catch up if you fall behind opposing racers.

Dirty Tactics

If you find yourself behind car with heavy damage you can deliberately collide with it in order to make it pitstop. This technique is advisable in closing stages of race. Forcing opponents off track or into oil and ice patches can also help you gain positions. Sometimes, it's preferable to wait behind gaggle of cars until they have all navigated corner, and then to accelerate past them on the straight, rather than trying to pass them before or during corner, which would probably result in you taking more damage or crashing off road.

Observing and Memorizing Tracks

Most important rule to success in any racing game is to learn and memorize tracks. This will allow you to anticipate corners and thus take faster line and overall quicker lap time will result. Regular glances at minimap will also help to refresh your memory. If you keep finding yourself crashing or spinning off track, then you are going too fast. Don't worry about winning at first. Instead, concentrate on staying on track as much as possible and memorizing track as you go. Changing to one of Auto Zoom Cameras and or changing Camera Height will give you greater view of track and should help you to make driving easier. Memorizing where oil and ice patches are is also essential to obtaining fast lap times. Some Tracks have multiple routes. You can judge which route is fastest by keeping eye on your lap time and best lap time that are shown on screen display.
